definition: The target dependency graph is the ctx.needs DAG of a project's magusfile: each node is a target (an exported function), each edge a dependency it composes. It is extracted statically from the magusfile source, so it shows every edge — including both arms of a runtime branch — and flags any dependency cycle (which the run path rejects during dispatch).

nodes.name: go-build
nodes.doc: Compiles the version-stamped magus binary.

nodes.name: dogfood
nodes.doc: Compiles magus-dev, the binary THIS worktree points its own git tooling at.

nodes.name: image-build
nodes.doc: Two axes, one charm each.

nodes.name: image-registries
nodes.doc: Reports the registries `magus run image-build` under the SAME charms will push to, and whether the credentials each one needs are actually present in the environment.

nodes.name: image-login
nodes.doc: Logs in to every registry the active mode publishes to, resolving each one's credentials through the workspace's secret provider.

nodes.name: image-scan
nodes.doc: Scans the image with trivy; the rw charm writes SARIF and gates on HIGH/CRITICAL.

nodes.name: security
nodes.doc: Gates on dependency LICENSE terms, which is a separate question from image_scan's vulnerability pass even though both drive trivy.

nodes.name: man-generate
nodes.doc: Renders the roff man pages into manpage/ (repo root).

nodes.name: changelog-generate
nodes.doc: CHANGELOG.md is a root artifact.

nodes.name: types-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the runtime BuzzObject maps before anything imports a host binding.

nodes.name: bindings-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the Go host bindings (std -> internal/interp/bindings/gen) from std.Module declarations.

nodes.name: magusfile-api-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the magusfile API surface lock: every member a magusfile can call on the magus namespace, one dotted name per line.

nodes.name: langservice-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the host-module snapshot the browser playground's completion and hover read (internal/langservice/manifest_data.go), from the same std declarations bindings_generate reads.

nodes.name: spells-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the compiled built-in spell bytecode (internal/spellruntime/gen), the Buzz value-type mirrors (internal/spellruntime/gen/types) and the per-module host declarations (internal/spellruntime/gen/decls), all driven by the go:generate directives in internal/spellruntime.

nodes.name: mocks-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the testify mocks (mockery, driven by .mockery.yaml) into each mocked interface's gen/ subdir.

nodes.name: skills-generate
nodes.doc: Reinstalls the agent skills from their embedded sources in cmd/magus/skills.

nodes.name: config-generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates the CLI config-flag plumbing from internal/config/config.go.

nodes.name: index-generate
nodes.doc: Renders MAGUS.md via `magus describe graph`.

nodes.name: graph-generate
nodes.doc: Exports both graphs the browser Graph Explorer can load, so its demo is this workspace's real graph rather than a fixture that would drift from the wire shape the adapter expects.

nodes.name: postflight
nodes.doc: Renders the insight report (hotspots, affinity, ownership, trend) to stdout.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.doc: Regenerates every *-generate sibling, then gates on drift (exclusive, scoped to cwd).

nodes.name: tapes
nodes.doc: Records every VHS tape in tapes/ into assets/gen/.

nodes.name: termcast-record
nodes.doc: Re-records tapes/core-loop.capture: the raw bytes a real magus prints to a real pseudo-terminal, driven by tapes/core-loop.session.sh.

nodes.name: termcast-showcase
nodes.doc: Renders tapes/core-loop.capture into the README's animated SVG.

nodes.name: termshots-generate
nodes.doc: Renders the still SVGs of magus's interactive terminal surfaces for the docs.

nodes.name: release-build
nodes.doc: Builds one release binary for one platform.

nodes.name: release-sign
nodes.doc: Signs dist/SHA256SUMS with the Ed25519 key in the MAGUS_SIGNING_KEY secret (see cmd/magus-utils/sign.go), then self-verifies the signature against the embedded release pubkey (internal/releasekey) before the release goes out — a cheap regression guard, safe to run here (unlike setup-magus, which can't depend on the magus source tree since it's reused by arbitrary external repos).

nodes.name: watch
nodes.doc: Rebuilds on every debounced change until interrupted; fs.watch BLOCKS, try/catch keeps it alive.

nodes.name: advice-test
nodes.doc: Runs the PR advisors' `test "..." {}` blocks.

nodes.name: test
nodes.doc: Tests with race detection, coverage, and a drift-gated coverage badge.

nodes.name: buzz-test
nodes.doc: Runs the in-file `test "..." {}` blocks in this repo's own root Buzz modules, through magus's embedded engine.

nodes.name: build
nodes.doc: Compiles one artifact: the host binary, or the container image under the `container` charm.

nodes.name: lint-build
nodes.doc: Builds ./custom-gcl, the golangci-lint carrying this repo's own linters.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.doc: Formats and builds the linter first, then golangci-lint, go vet, markdownlint, and shellcheck.

nodes.name: format
nodes.doc: Regenerates, then formats Go, tidies `go.mod`, and formats Markdown.

nodes.name: ci
nodes.doc: Runs the CI gates through their declared dependencies.

nodes.name: completion-test
nodes.doc: Exercises the completion scripts magus SHIPS, each inside the official image for its shell.

nodes.name: compress-cgo-test
nodes.doc: Runs internal/compress's tests under the CGO tags, which the ordinary test target cannot reach.

nodes.name: ci-shard
nodes.doc: Translates a `magus affected --plan` (read on stdin) into GitHub Actions shard-matrix outputs; the gha charm writes $GITHUB_OUTPUT, otherwise the matrix is only previewed.

nodes.name: deploy-generate
nodes.doc: deploy-generate assembles gen/site: the exact tree the Pages deploy publishes, docs at the root of it and the console app under /console/.

nodes.name: toolchain-report
nodes.doc: serve is the workspace-root dev loop for BOTH deployables.

nodes.name: test
nodes.doc: test runs the node:test suite over the bundled *.test.ts (the shell/view/tiling/keymap unit tests) and renders a line-coverage badge from the run.

nodes.name: build
nodes.doc: build bundles the whole app into gen/ (esbuild via pnpm: the surface bundles + CSS, then copy-static assembles index/manifest/sw + scaffolds + assets) and gates on drift: a clean checkout only goes dirty when a source edit was not rebuilt and committed.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.doc: lint keeps TypeScript, CSS, and source formatting errors out of the console CI gate.

nodes.name: security
nodes.doc: security audits the dependency tree against the npm advisory database.

nodes.name: ci
nodes.doc: 'ci' is the anchor `magus affected ci` keys off: the lint gate (tsc), the unit tests, the build-plus-drift-gate, and the advisory audit, all first-class ci steps.

nodes.name: index-generate
nodes.doc: index-generate refreshes MAGUS.md (the target catalog + dependency graph) from this magusfile, so it stays in lockstep with the targets.

nodes.name: content-generate
nodes.doc: content-generate regenerates the committed docs Markdown derived from the Go source tree: the Buzz stdlib module reference (cmd/magus-docs, from the host module registry), the built-in spell reference plus the spells.md table (cmd/magus-spelldocs), the Markdown manpages (cmd/magus-manpage -format md, from internal/clispec), and the worked examples in knowledge.md (cmd/magus-examples, captured from a fixture graph).

nodes.name: site-generate
nodes.doc: site-generate owns publication.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.doc: generate is the one public docs publication target.

nodes.name: conventions
nodes.doc: conventions holds the prose corpus to the conventions page it publishes: no shell prompt in a command block, no pinned version standing in for example output, no backticked path that has since moved.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.doc: lint runs the client-side TypeScript gates: tsc for type errors and Biome for the banned patterns (no `any`, no non-null assertions - see biome.json).

nodes.name: buzz-test
nodes.doc: buzz-test runs render's in-file `test "..." {}` blocks through `magus buzz`, in --embedded mode so render's markdown/encoding imports resolve.

nodes.name: security
nodes.doc: security audits what actually ships against the npm advisory database.

nodes.name: build-playground
nodes.doc: build-playground rebuilds the WebAssembly interpreter the playground loads: the stock Go toolchain compiles ../cmd/buzz-playground straight into gen/playground/buzz.wasm, and Go's own wasm_exec.js glue is copied beside it.

nodes.name: build-mermaid
nodes.doc: build-mermaid bundles the vendored mermaid library (src/vendor/mermaid.js -> mermaid@11) into gen/assets/mermaid.js.

nodes.name: build-hljs
nodes.doc: build-hljs bundles the vendored highlight.js library (src/vendor/hljs.js -> highlight.js@11) into gen/assets/hljs.js.

nodes.name: build-playground-editor
nodes.doc: build-playground-editor bundles the CodeMirror editor the playground loads into gen/playground/editor.js.

nodes.name: render
nodes.doc: render is the fast docs/blog iteration path; it skips generated content, bundles, and drift checks.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.doc: lint is the templates' static-analysis gate: the TypeScript type-check (tsc --noEmit) plus Biome's banned patterns (no `any`, no non-null assertions - see biome.json, which mirrors libs/textsearch's rules so the whole workspace writes TypeScript the same way).

nodes.name: test
nodes.doc: test runs the OpenCode plugin's transport cases: does it ASK magus correctly (the top-level `hook` subcommand, the input on stdin) and handle each decision the way it declares.

nodes.name: ci

nodes.name: lint
nodes.doc: lint validates every task file against the schema and checks that each named constraint predicate exists.

nodes.name: security
